title: Nowhere-zero 4-flows in graphs excluding a proper minor of the Petersen graph
summary: Tutte's $4$-flow conjecture asserts that every finite bridgeless graph with no Petersen minor admits a nowhere-zero $4$-flow. Let $P$ be the Petersen graph and let $e\in E(P)$. We prove that every finite bridgeless $(P/e)$-minor-free multigraph admits a nowhere-zero $4$-flow. Since $P-e$ and $P/e$ are the two maximal proper minors of $P$, combining our result with the theorem of Thomas and Thomson for $(P-e)$-minor-free graphs shows that, for every proper minor $R$ of $P$, every finite bridgeless $R$-minor-free graph admits a nowhere-zero $4$-flow.
